commands.label: cli_crash_diag
commands.cmd: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ram=(Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem); $pct=[math]::Round(($ram.TotalVisibleMemorySize-$ram.FreePhysicalMemory)/$ram.TotalVisibleMemorySize*100,1); $evts=Get-EventLog -LogName Application -Newest 50 -EntryType Error -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.Source -match 'Claude|Application Error|Windows Error' -or $_.Message -match 'claude'} | Select-Object -First 5 TimeGenerated,Source,Message; $logdir="$env:APPDATA\Claude\logs"; $logs=if(Test-Path $logdir){Get-ChildItem $logdir -Filter '*.log' | Select-Object Name,@{N='SizeMB';E={[math]::Round($_.Length/1MB,2)}},LastWriteTime}else{'no logs dir'}; $isAdmin=([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator); $bcdeditTest=try{$r=bcdedit /enum {current} 2>&1; 'ok'}catch{'FAILED: '+$_}; $out=@{ts=(Get-Date -f 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ');ram_pct=$pct;is_admin=$isAdmin;bcdedit_accessible=$bcdeditTest;crash_events=($evts|ForEach-Object{"$($_.TimeGenerated) [$($_.Source)] $($_.Message.Substring(0,[math]::Min(120,$_.Message.Length)))"}); log_files=$logs}; $out|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3|Out-File "$env:APPDATA\Claude\diag_output.json" -Encoding utf8; Write-Host 'diag done'"
commands.note: Check RAM%, admin status, bcdedit access, Event Log for crashes. Safe-mode crash likely = CLI calls bcdedit without admin -> UAC blocks -> crash.

commands.note: Copy diag output to relay folder for cloud pickup
